metadata.title: MDN Travel — Luxury Concierge & Booking Requests
metadata.description: Pick a service, open a request, and our team handles everything for you.

home.heroTagline: Tell us what you need — our concierge team arranges it all, from stays and yachts to private events.
home.servicesTitle: Nine services, one team behind them
home.servicesLead: Choose the service you need and we'll come back with a detailed offer within hours.
home.howTitle: Three steps — we finish the rest
home.step1Desc: Nine concierge services, from stays to private events.
home.step2Desc: A short form: your details, preferred contact method, and what you need.
home.step3Desc: We arrange everything and stay with you until your service is complete.

service.experienceTitle: You choose the mood — we arrange everything around it.
service.experienceBody: It starts with a short conversation about what you have in mind. Then we come back with one clear offer — hand-picked, fully arranged, and followed by your concierge from the first call to the last detail.
service.feature1Desc: One person follows your request from start to finish
service.feature2Desc: No endless options — a single tailored proposal
service.feature3Desc: Bookings, transfers, and details handled for you
service.feature4Desc: We stay close until the service is complete
service.requestBody: Send us the details and the concierge team comes back to you within 6 hours at most.
service.noPaymentNote: No payment now — requesting is completely free

request.title: Open a request
request.pageLead: No instant bookings and no payment now. We read your request ourselves and come back with one detailed offer.
request.bullet2: A reference code to track your request
request.detailsPlaceholder: Dates, number of guests, city, and anything you'd like us to know…
request.privacyNote: By sending this request you agree to our privacy policy.
request.submitError: Something went wrong — please try again.

success.title: Your request arrived safely
success.body: The concierge team is reviewing the details now and will contact you within 6 hours. Keep the reference code to follow your request.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or is no longer available.

track.title: Track your request
track.notFound: We couldn't find a request matching that code and phone number.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.invalidPhone: Please enter a valid phone number.

footer.tagline: Private concierge for travel and events. Part of the MDN family.

devUi.title: Component library
devUi.tagline: Every shared component and variant, backed by the brand tokens. Review side by side at /en/dev/ui and /ar/dev/ui.
devUi.timelineNoteCurrent: Current step — we are preparing your offer now
devUi.cardDarkBody: Gradient panel with grid motif and a soft navy marketing shadow.
devUi.cardLightBody: Flat Primer-style surface for the admin dashboard and form cards.
devUi.panelBody: Gradient mesh with a radial royal-blue bloom and a faint 1px grid — the section wrapper for marketing surfaces.
